The '''Infinity Blade''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword weapon]] that can be obtained by combining the {{Name|Galaxy Sword|class=inline}} with {{Name|Galaxy Soul|1|class=inline}} and {{Name|Cinder Shard|20|class=inline}} three times in the [[Forge]]. It is the most powerful sword in the game.

Obtaining it unlocks the [[Achievements|Infinite Power]] achievement.
